name: gkmur
description: Gabriel Murray's personal Claude skills marketplace

plugins.name: moodboard
plugins.description: Your saved visual taste, as a creative mind your AI can draw on. Point it at any reference library (folders of images, a Pinterest mirror, screenshots) - it compiles a reusable taste profile once, then applies your aesthetic to anything you build with an adjustable influence dial: strictly mirror one reference, channel a collection, or let your whole taste quietly season the work. No external services; everything runs on local files.

plugins.name: adhd
plugins.description: Shape output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /adhd; stays on until 'stop adhd mode'. Optional always-on SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: maintainer-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run a single orchestrator session that wakes on a heartbeat, triages every personal repo's queue, and directs one background worker agent per repo to land safe work autonomously - escalating only decision-ready briefs to Gabe. Claude Code port of steipete's Codex maintainer loop: /loop 5m heartbeat, background agents as worker threads, SendMessage to steer, gh-driven triage, PR-only landings.
